source_sentences: Financial Management, Minor Course Requirements Required: Units 70-391 Finance 9 70-493 Valuation and Financial Modeling 9 70-207 Probability and Statistics for Business Applications 9 or 36-200 Reasoning with Data or 36-220 Engineering Statistics and Quality Control or 36-218 Probability Theory for Computer Scientists or 36-225 Introduction to Probability Theory Elective Courses ( choose three ) : 70-398 International Finance 9 70-428 Financial Statement Analysis 9 70-492 Investment Analysis 9 70-495 Corporate Finance 9 73-103 Principles of Macroeconomics 9 73-337 Business of Blockchain 9 21-270 Introduction to Mathematical Finance 9 Double-Counting While there are no double counting restrictions between the minor and the student's home college general education requirements, only one minor course may double-count with any other major or minor requirements.
The Minor in Operations and Supply Chain Management allows an additional double-count for a total of 2 courses that may double-count with any other major or minor requirements.
